description: Audited paper resource year; normalized per full-year source peak; daily service schedules shifted to local mean solar time; 8760 intervals, no initial inventory row.
wave_attribution: Open-Meteo Marine historical wave data where indicated; see per-site source URLs and source descriptions. NOAA/NASA data where indicated.

sites.label: Near Anchorage, Alaska
sites.note: 365-day hourly extension of the short-horizon real-resource profile. The horizon starts on 2024-01-01 UTC and stops on 2024-12-30 UTC to keep the optimization at exactly 8760 hourly samples despite 2024 being a leap year. Closest active NOAA buoy with both wind and wave history found near Anchorage.
sites.wind_source: NOAA NDBC hourly mean wind speed cubed
